username_not_normalized.message: Username "{new_username}" is not normalized. Please make sure the username is lowercase and does not contain any whitespace.

deprecated_long_lived_access_token_witho.description:
"{client}" created a long-lived access token without a recent sign-in or a confirmation of your identity. From Home Assistant 2027.5, creating a long-lived access token needs one of them.

If a tool created this token, check if it supports signing in right before creating it. In **Profile** > **Security**, Home Assistant asks you to confirm your identity when needed.
deprecated_long_lived_access_token_witho.title: Creating long-lived access tokens will need a recent sign-in
